payload.note: StartOfRefresh objectives are checked at the start of Refresh — before retrieve, draw missions, advance-time, recruit/build, and deploy. payload.rule: Yoda's training: once per round, reroll one blank die on a mission or combat attack rolled by the leader bearing the Yoda ring.
